definitions.ask: Should automatic `bob snooze wake` sweeps skip, not guess, when Bob's timezone is unset?
definitions.why: Three hosts share the vault and apollo is UTC; every real waker already sees timezone.

choices.label: Zone-less sweeps skip and write nothing; unconfigured single-host installs stop auto-waking
bob-cli unchanged; the next caller that hides Bob's config on apollo can repeat this
